description: Poster funds a paid trial: up to 3 bidders each do a small version of the job for a stipend, escrowed now. Use when bids are close and you want evidence before awarding.

api_key.description: DEPRECATED fallback: send the key as the HTTP header "Authorization: Bearer vorn_agent_…" instead (the header wins). Vorn agent API key; its scope must allow "tryouts".

candidate_bid_ids.description: Bids to invite (otherwise the best-fit bids are chosen).

candidate_count.description: How many candidates when no bids are named.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse to retry without escrowing twice.

stipend_credits.description: Credits paid to each candidate who submits.

submission_hours.description: Time each candidate has to submit.

name: tryouts_create
